tour.p1: Let me show you this screen in under a minute. You can skip it and watch it again with the ? button at the bottom left.
tour.p2: Organize your boards in groups like Work or Personal. Use + to create one and right-click to rename it or change its color.
tour.p3: Mark a board with the ⭐ and it will always be in Favorites. Recent shows what you edited last.
tour.p4: Click to open it. Right-click to rename, duplicate, move or export it to share. You can also drag it onto a group on the left.
tour.p5: Type part of the name (shortcut {{key}}) or use the filters below.
tour.p6: Choose a name, group, background and, if you like, a template so you don't start from scratch. Shortcut: {{key}}.
tour.p7: From here you can watch this tutorial again, check the shortcuts or turn tips on and off.

tableros.sugerenciaFav: Mark the boards you use most with the ⭐ to find them quickly in Favorites.

ajustes.seAplicaATodos: Applies to all new and existing threads.
ajustes.manuscritaDaElAspecto: Handwritten looks like paper; normal is easier to read in long notes.
ajustes.unClicDeChinche: A pin click when pinning, a paper rustle when dropping, tape when sticking, a “tick” when checking off a task and crumpled paper when throwing something in the trash.

ajustes.alineaLosElementosAl: Aligns items when you drop them.
ajustes.abrirElUltimoTablero: Open the last board on startup
ajustes.unChatEnCada: A chat in every board that suggests ideas, summarizes, sorts the sheet into zones and creates notes, lists and threads. It's free and off by default.
ajustes.buscandoOllamaEnTu: Looking for Ollama on your PC…
ajustes.armaTablerosMasCompletos: Builds more complete boards and writes more useful ideas. 2.5 GB; without a graphics card it takes about a minute per request.
ajustes.respondeMasRapidoEn: Answers faster on modest PCs, but its answers are simpler. 2 GB.
ajustes.oPegalaAquiEmpieza: Or paste it here (starts with AQ. or AIza)
ajustes.compruebaQueElAsistente: Checks that the assistant answers with what you chose.

ajustes.buscandoImagenesYArchivos: Looking for images and files that no board uses…

ajustes.guardaTodoEnUn: Saves everything in a single .zip file wherever you choose (a USB drive, OneDrive…). Chinchero also saves a copy of your boards every time you open it.
ajustes.usaUnaCarpetaDe: Use a Chinchero folder you already have, for example from another computer.

tour.p1: This is where you customize Chinchero. Everything is saved instantly; there's no Save button.
tour.p2: Language, light or dark theme, thread color, note font and sounds. The preview changes as you choose.
tour.p3: The background for new sheets, whether items appear slightly tilted and whether they snap to the grid.
tour.p4: It's off by default. If you turn it on, every board gets a chat that suggests ideas, summarizes and sorts the sheet. With Ollama everything stays on your PC; with Gemini you use a free Google key.
tour.p5: Everything lives in this folder, images included. Make a backup (.zip) every now and then and get it back with Restore backup, or open the folder from another computer with Open existing data.
tour.p6: If you already know the app, turn them off. If you want a refresher, reset them.

ajustes.sugerenciaCopia: Get into the habit of making a backup before switching PCs or formatting.

ajustesIa.ayudaGemini: The easiest option: nothing to install. Free with your Google account, with a daily usage limit. It needs internet, and the sheet's text is sent to Google to answer.
ajustesIa.ayudaOllama: To use it offline: everything stays on your PC and nothing leaves your computer. Chinchero installs Ollama and a model for you (about 4 GB to download; they take up about 6 GB); it answers more slowly on PCs without a graphics card.
ajustesIa.claveGuardadaEn: Key saved on this PC ({{hint}}), encrypted. It's never saved in your boards or backups.

guia.intro: Gemini is free with your Google account. Follow these steps in your browser and leave this window open: Chinchero notices by itself when you copy the key.

guia.p2: Sign in with your Google account
guia.p2Ayuda: The same one you use for Gmail or YouTube. If you're already signed in, go to the next step.
guia.p3Ayuda: It's at the top right. If it asks for a project, choose “Create project” and then “Create key”. If you already have a key in the list, click it.
guia.p4Ayuda: Click “Copy” next to the key. You don't need to paste it anywhere.

sugerencias.undo: Made a mistake? Ctrl+Z undoes any change, deleting included.
sugerencias.pan: Drag the background to move around and use the wheel to zoom. To select several items, hold Shift and drag a box.

tour.p1: Let me show you the basics in 2 minutes. Some steps will ask you to do something; you can skip them if you prefer. This tutorial is always in the ? button at the top.
tour.p2: Notes, cards, lists, text, images, links, files, stickers, zones, drawing and threads. Hover over each one to see its shortcut.
tour.tarea3: Press {{key}} and click an empty spot
tour.tarea3SinAtajo: Choose the note and click an empty spot
tour.p3: Choose the note in the bar on the left (or press {{key}}) and click wherever you want to put it.
tour.p3SinAtajo: Choose the note in the bar on the left and click wherever you want to put it.
tour.p4: While you type, a bar appears for bold, lists and font size. To edit later, double-click the item.
tour.p5: Drag to move. The little squares in the corners resize it and, if you bring the mouse just outside a corner, you can rotate it. The floating bar changes color, pin or locks it.
tour.tarea6: Drag from one pin to another
tour.p6: Drag from one item's pin to another's. Click a thread to change its color or give it a label. Shift + drag moves the pin.
tour.p7: Draw a zone and everything you put inside will move with it. Great for categories or Kanban-style columns.
tour.p8: Drag the background to move around and use the wheel to zoom in or out. To select several, hold Shift and drag a box.
tour.p9: Each board has sheets, like Excel. Double-click to rename, drag them to reorder and right-click to duplicate or change their color.
tour.p10: Everything saves itself. If something goes wrong, {{key}} undoes it.
tour.p11: {{key}} searches notes, photos and lists in all sheets, and gives you quick access to every action.
tour.p12: Here you have the shortcuts, this tutorial and the tip options. Start pinning ideas! 📌

pedidos.tareas: Find the pending tasks on the sheet and create a list with them.
